findings.problem: 「个人」 is the adjective/account-type sense ('personal, individual') - the prefix of 个人资料 - not the noun for a person. This namespace already uses 人员 for people in prose (compose.label 添加人员或智能体; create.channel_description). Under a name and title the badge can be parsed as an account type rather than an identity marker. Still understandable, so non-gating.
findings.fix: 「真人」 - the established Chinese contrast to 智能体/机器人 on AI surfaces (真人客服), and it reads as an identity badge, not as 个人资料's prefix.

findings.problem: 'Con người' is the collective/abstract noun for humankind; a one-word identity badge in Vietnamese product copy reads more naturally with a concrete noun. Meaning survives, so non-gating.
findings.fix: 「Người thật」 (real person - the settled human-vs-bot contrast) or 「Người dùng」 if the user framing is preferred. Keep 「Tác nhân」 unchanged.
findings.status: open by design - recorded in the round-1 receipt and carried to the PR thread; the frozen catalogue bytes are unchanged, so this was not silently fixed in the copy

findings.problem: Label and clock time run together with no separator. The four other locales that mark the value use a colon (fr « Heure locale : », es « Hora local: », ru « Местное время: », vi « Giờ địa phương: »), and the card renders icon + label + time, so the missing colon reads as a run-on. RTL order itself is correct: logical order, no manual bidi controls.
